subject: general
question: Who among the following was the pioneer of widow remarriages in Maharashtra and also started a girls' school in Poona along with his wife?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jyotirao Govindrao Phule**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jyotirao Govindrao Phule** was a social reformer and activist from Maharashtra who played a crucial role in the promotion of widow remarriages.
 
• He, along with his wife Savitribai Phule, started the first school for girls in Poona (now Pune) in 1848.
 
• Phule's efforts were pioneering in challenging the prevailing caste system and advocating for the rights of the oppressed, including women and lower castes.
 
• His work laid the foundation for subsequent social reform movements in Maharashtra and beyond.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jyotirao Phule** was born on 11 April 1827 in Satara district, Maharashtra.
 
• He was also the founder of the Satyashodhak Samaj (Society of Truth Seekers), which aimed at achieving social equality.
 
• Phule's literary works include the play "Tritiya Ratna" and the book "Gulamgiri" (Slavery).
 
• His contributions to education and social reform have made him a revered figure in Indian history, particularly in Maharashtra.
